en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 remains in force as Saudel edges closer
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was about 250 kilometres east-southeast of Hong Kong early Wednesday; the Observatory said the chance of a Strong Wind Signal remains relatively low.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal No. 1 remained in force early on Wednesday as Tropical Storm Saudel continued to track across the northern part of the South China Sea.

At 1am, Saudel was estimated to be about 250 kilometres east-southeast of Hong Kong and was forecast to move northeast at about 12 kilometres per hour, edging closer to the coast of eastern Guangdong while intensifying gradually.

Under the combined effect of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, local winds were expected to be occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. The Observatory said that unless Saudel intensifies significantly and its associated strong winds come closer to the Pearl River Estuary, the chance of strong winds generally over Hong Kong remains not high.
The signal is expected to stay in force through Wednesday morning. Members of the public should continue to pay attention to the latest weather information issued by the Observatory.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號繼續生效 沙德爾靠近粵東沿岸
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾周三凌晨位於本港東南偏東約250公里；天文台指改發三號強風信號機會仍相對較低。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號於周三凌晨繼續生效，熱帶風暴沙德爾繼續橫過南海北部。
凌晨1時，沙德爾集結在香港東南偏東約250公里，預料向東北移動，時速約12公里，逐漸靠近廣東東部沿岸並逐步增強。
受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。天文台指，除非沙德爾顯著增強且其相關強風區更接近珠江口，否則本港普遍吹強風的機會不大。
信號預料會維持至周三上午。市民應繼續留意天文台發出的最新天氣資訊。
